resources.string: Voice service settings
Configure a trusted MeBot voice service separately from your text connection. Nothing connects or starts automatically.
ChatGPT text connection
Your ChatGPT sign-in remains unchanged and is used for supported text features. It does not grant OpenAI API Realtime access or pay for API voice usage.
Separate OpenAI API voice service
This optional service must be set up by you or a trusted operator. API voice usage is billed separately from ChatGPT and may incur charges.
Saving these details only stores the service URL and token. It does not check the service, request a session, access your microphone, or start a call.
HTTPS voice service URL
https://voice.example.com
Use the public HTTPS base URL for your trusted MeBot broker. Query strings and fragments are not allowed.
MeBot service token
Paste the service token from your operator
Saved token is hidden; leave blank to keep it
This is a service token issued by the broker, not an OpenAI developer API key.
A service token is stored. Leave blank to keep it for this same URL, or enter a replacement.
The token is encrypted in private app storage and is excluded from feed backups.
Save voice service
Save does not make a network request. Test the service separately when you choose.
Enter a valid public HTTPS service URL without a query or fragment.
The service token must be 32–4096 characters with no whitespace.
Enter a service token for this URL before saving.
Service capability status
Not checked yet. Use Test service to explicitly request a capability check.
Test checks only the broker capability endpoint. It does not create a voice session or send microphone audio.
Save your URL/token changes before checking status.
Checking broker capabilities…
Test service
Live Realtime voice
Recording transcription
The service reports that live voice is available. This is a status result only; no call was started.
The service reports that recording transcription is configured. This is a status result only; no recording or audio upload has started.
Remove voice service
Remove this voice service?
This removes only the separately stored voice service URL and token. Your ChatGPT text connection and its settings stay unchanged.
